title: S12T03 - Add console CSRF origin and session token protection
description: Console mutating endpoints currently require POST and confirm=yes, but no visible per-server token or Origin/Host validation guards.
acceptanceCriteria: Every mutating console POST requires a per-server token and rejects invalid Origin/Host combinations.
Console tests cover missing token, bad token, cross-origin POST, valid local POST, and explicit remote-bind warning behavior.
closedReason: Console POST security controls implemented and verified
